title: IPAFFS Messaging & Integrations
description: Is anything stuck between IPAFFS and its partners? Service Bus backlogs and dead letters, partner calls, integration jobs.

panels.title: Waiting (shared Service Bus)
panels.description: Messages waiting to be consumed across the whole classic namespace, now.

panels.title: New dead letters in range
panels.description: Change in the dead-letter count over the selected range, classic namespace. Negative means someone cleared a DLQ.

panels.title: Service Bus server errors
panels.description: Errors on the Service Bus side in range, classic plus this namespace's own.

panels.title: Partner call failures

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where type !in ("InProc", "SQL", "redis") and type !has "ServiceBus"
| extend partner = case(
    target contains "dynamics.com" or name contains "/trade-crm-adapter/", "Dynamics CRM",
    name contains "/trade-risk-assessment/" or name contains "/commodity-risk-categorisation-decider/", "Risk engine",
    name contains "/trade-notify/", "Notify (trade-notify)",
    name contains "/trade-delegated-authority/", "Delegated authority",
    name contains "/mdm/", "MDM",
    name contains "/graphql/", "Approved establishments (GraphQL)",
    name contains "/address-lookup", "Address lookup",
    name contains "/trade-imports-cloning/", "Trade imports cloning",
    target matches regex @"^ref(-[a-z]+)?[.]azure[.]defra[.]cloud", "Reference data (RDS)",
    target contains "search.windows.net", "Azure AI Search",
    type == "Azure blob", "Blob storage",
    target contains "antivirus", "Antivirus",
    target contains "login.microsoftonline.com" or target contains "b2clogin.com", "Entra ID / B2C",
    target contains "gateway", "Trade API gateway (other)",
    "")
| where partner != ""
| extend failed = success == false and not(type == "Azure blob" and resultCode == "404")
| summarize v = 100.0 * countif(failed) / count()

panels.description: Failed outbound calls to external partners from this namespace. Blob 404s (existence checks) are not counted.

panels.title: Risk engine fallback

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where name in ("risk-assessment-risk-engine-fallback-count", "risk-assessment-risk-engine-success-count")

panels.description: Share of risk assessments that fell back to the default because the risk engine call failed.

panels.title: Integration jobs failing

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where not(name matches regex "^(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS)( |$)") and name !contains "cache"
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, success) by name
| summarize v = countif(success == false)

panels.description: Scheduled jobs whose most recent run in range failed. See the jobs table below.

panels.description: Now, largest first. A topic's figure is the sum over its subscriptions: Azure Monitor does not split by subscription.

panels.title: Dead-lettered over time (top 8)

panels.title: Waiting over time (top 8)
panels.description: Rising while incoming is flat or zero means a stuck or missing consumer.

panels.title: Messaging seen from the apps (App Insights, this namespace only)
Who sends and who consumes

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where type == "Microsoft.ServiceBus"
| extend entity = tostring(split(target, "/")[0]), op = tostring(split(name, ".")[1])
| summarize Sent = countif(op == "send"), ["Send failures"] = countif(op == "send" and success == false),
    Completed = countif(op == "complete"), Senders = make_set_if(replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", ""), op == "send"),
    Consumers = make_set_if(replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", ""), op in ("receiveMessages", "complete")) by Entity = entity
| extend Senders = strcat_array(Senders, ", "), Consumers = strcat_array(Consumers, ", ")
| order by Sent desc

defaults.noValue: No Service Bus traffic from this namespace

panels.description: Unlike the metrics above, this is only this namespace's pods. An entity with senders and no consumers here is consumed elsewhere (Logic App, BTMS, another namespace) or not at all.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where type == "Microsoft.ServiceBus"
| extend entity = tostring(split(target, "/")[0]), op = tostring(split(name, ".")[1])
| where op in ("send", "complete")
| summarize n = count() by series = strcat(entity, " ", op), bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

| where type !in ("InProc", "SQL", "redis") and type !has "ServiceBus"
| extend partner = case(
    target contains "dynamics.com" or name contains "/trade-crm-adapter/", "Dynamics CRM",
    name contains "/trade-risk-assessment/" or name contains "/commodity-risk-categorisation-decider/", "Risk engine",
    name contains "/trade-notify/", "Notify (trade-notify)",
    name contains "/trade-delegated-authority/", "Delegated authority",
    name contains "/mdm/", "MDM",
    name contains "/graphql/", "Approved establishments (GraphQL)",
    name contains "/address-lookup", "Address lookup",
    name contains "/trade-imports-cloning/", "Trade imports cloning",
    target matches regex @"^ref(-[a-z]+)?[.]azure[.]defra[.]cloud", "Reference data (RDS)",
    target contains "search.windows.net", "Azure AI Search",
    type == "Azure blob", "Blob storage",
    target contains "antivirus", "Antivirus",
    target contains "login.microsoftonline.com" or target contains "b2clogin.com", "Entra ID / B2C",
    target contains "gateway", "Trade API gateway (other)",
    "")
| where partner != ""
| extend failed = success == false and not(type == "Azure blob" and resultCode == "404")
| summarize Calls = count(), ['Fail %'] = round(100.0 * countif(failed) / count(), 2), ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)),

    ['Called by'] = strcat_array(make_set(replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", ""), 5), ", ") by Partner = partner
| order by ['Fail %'] desc, Calls desc

panels.title: Risk engine: answered vs fallback

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where name in ("risk-assessment-risk-engine-fallback-count", "risk-assessment-risk-engine-success-count")
| summarize n = sum(valueSum) by series = iff(name endswith "fallback-count", "fallback", "answered"), bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.description: From riskassessment-service's own counters. Fallback means the CHED got the default risk decision.

panels.title: Scheduled jobs

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
| where not(name matches regex "^(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS)( |$)") and name !contains "cache"
| summarize Runs = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), ['p95 s'] = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 1000, 1),
    ['Last run'] = max(timestamp), ['Last success'] = maxif(timestamp, success == true), Service = take_any(replace_regex(cloud_RoleName, @"^.*[.]", "")) by Job = name
| extend Status = case(Failed == Runs, "failing", Failed > 0, "some failures", "ok")
| project Status, Job, Service, Runs, Failed, ['p95 s'], ['Last run'], ['Last success']
| order by Failed desc, Runs desc

defaults.noValue: No scheduled jobs ran in range

panels.description: Scheduled tasks reported as requests (reference data sync, MDM download, archiving). Cache-clearing tasks are left out.

panels.title: Retry and failure events

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
 (customEvents
 | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
 | where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
 | where name matches regex "(?i)(retry|fail|error|poll|timeout|deadletter)"
 | summarize n = count() by series = name, bin(timestamp, $__interval)),
 (customMetrics
 | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
 | where (tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace" or (isempty(tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"])) and "$namespace" in ("tst", "pre", "prd") and cloud_RoleName !contains "."))
 | where name == "Item_Retry_Count"
 | summarize n = sum(valueSum) by series = name, bin(timestamp, $__interval))
| order by timestamp asc

panels.description: BIP, checks and decision retry events, *FailedEvent, SOAP search poll failures and Item_Retry_Count.
